  Scenario: AC21 Decision record and store commit together (new in rwb-document; BR8)
    Given the decision record write is forced to fail inside the store transaction
    When a court notice is stored for case "RW-2026-000123"
    Then no document row, no document_field row and no outbox row exists for the notice

  Scenario: AC22 Unknown document returns 404 (new in rwb-document)
    Given no document exists with the requested document ID on case "RW-2026-000123"
    When the caller requests GET content for that document ID
    Then the system answers 404 and returns no content

  Scenario: AC23 Copy activity retried or timed out (new in rwb-document; X8)
    Given the copyPending activity of DocumentIntakeWorkflow fails on its first attempt or does not complete within its activity timeout
    When the activity is retried
    Then the file is copied once, the row moves from COPY_PENDING to STORED and no second copy is written
